parameters.subject: ={{ 'Weekly sentiment summary - ' + $json.business_name }}
parameters.message:
={{ (() => { const s = $json; const e = (x) => String(x ?? '').replace(/&/g, '&').replace(//g, '>'); const total = Number(s.total) || 0; const pct = (n) => total ? Math.round(100 * Number(n) / total) + '%' : '0%'; const mins = s.avg_minutes_to_acknowledge; const speed = mins == null ? 'no cases handled yet' : (mins < 60 ? mins + ' min' : (Math.round(mins / 6) / 10) + ' hours'); const row = (label, value, note) => `${label}${value}${note || ''}`; const warn = Number(s.still_unhandled) > 0 ? `
${e(s.still_unhandled)} alert(s) have not been marked as handled yet.
` : ''; return `

Weekly sentiment summary

${e(s.business_name)} - the last 7 days

${warn} ${row('Messages received', e(total), 'Average rating ' + e(s.avg_rating ?? '-') + ' / 5')} ${row('Positive', e(s.positive), pct(s.positive))} ${row('Neutral', e(s.neutral), pct(s.neutral))} ${row('Negative', e(s.negative), pct(s.negative))} ${row('Health or safety concerns', e(s.safety_cases), '')} ${row('Questions or suggestions', e(s.reply_requests), 'need a reply from you')} ${row('Alerts sent to you', e(s.alerts_sent), '')} ${row('Marked as handled', e(s.acknowledged), 'Average time to respond: ' + e(speed))} ${row('Reminders sent', e(s.reminders_sent), 'alerts left unhandled too long')} ${row('Could not be read automatically', e(s.unclassified), 'you were emailed these to read yourself')} ${row('Marked for a second look', e(s.flagged_for_review), 'the system was less sure')}

Sent automatically every Monday morning. Reply to this email if anything looks wrong.

`; })() }}
